description: Na₃SnCAsO₇ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/m space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.42-2.71 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.38-2.79 Å. Sn is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted SnO₆ octahedra that share corners with four equivalent AsO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Sn-O bond distances ranging from 2.37-2.62 Å. C is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of C-O bond distances ranging from 1.29-1.32 Å. As is bonded to four O atoms to form AsO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent SnO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 51-71°. There are a spread of As-O bond distances ranging from 1.72-1.75 Å. There are six inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to four Na and one C atom to form distorted ONa₄C trigonal bipyramids that share corners with two equivalent ONa₄C trigonal bipyramids and  an edgeedge with one ONa₂SnAs tetrahedra. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Sn, and one C atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Sn, and one C atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Sn, and one As atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na, one Sn, and one As atom to form edge-sharing ONa₂SnAs tetrahedra. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two equivalent Na, one Sn, and one As atom.
